name: United States
summary: North American federal republic spanning continental, subarctic, and Pacific bioclimatic zones. Experiences acute regional environmental stressors including Western wildfire smoke dispersion, Atlantic hurricane intensification, and Gulf coastal inundation, alongside leading absolute clean technology capital deployment.

pm25.name: Annual Mean PM2.5 Exposure
pm25.source_dataset: State of Global Air (SOGA) 2024 / Global Burden of Disease
pm25.context: 1.56x the WHO 2021 annual guideline (5 µg/m³); meets US EPA primary annual standard of 9.0 µg/m³.

temp_anomaly.name: Surface Temperature Anomaly
temp_anomaly.context: Relative to 1951-1980 climatological baseline; contiguous US recorded third warmest summer in instrumental history.

temp_trend.name: 30-Year Warming Trend Rate
temp_trend.context: Linear least-squares warming trend across trailing 30-year observational window (1994-2023).

co2_total.name: Total Territorial Fossil CO2
co2_total.context: 13.0% share of global fossil emissions; second largest national total behind China.

co2_per_capita.name: Per Capita Fossil CO2
co2_per_capita.context: High per capita emissions driven by extensive transport sector mileage and high thermal conditioning demand.

forest_share.name: Forest Cover Fraction
forest_share.source_dataset: Global Forest Resources Assessment via World Bank (AG.LND.FRST.ZS)
forest_share.context: Total forest area ~3,100,000 km² spanning Eastern deciduous woodlands and Pacific Northwest conifer stands.

renewables_share.name: Renewable Share of Electricity
renewables_share.context: Generation from wind (10.2%), utility/rooftop solar (5.6%), and conventional hydropower (5.7%).

population.name: Total Population & Density
population.context: Arithmetic population density of 37 people/km²; urban population fraction is 83.3%.
